extDescription.message: Blocks new tabs from specified websites

allowCtrlClick.message: Allow ctrl/shift clicks and middle mouse clicks

urlBeginDesc.message: URLs that start with one of the listed URL beginnings will be blocked from opening new tabs

wrongUrlPatternPromt.message:
The input '$url$' does not seem to follow the pattern 'https://www.example.com'.

emptyUrlPromt.message:

permissionText.message: To detect tabs opened via <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd> click or middle mouse button, the extension needs additional permissions.

privacyText.message: No data is collected, stored, or transmitted. Everything happens locally in your browser.

openSourceText.message: Fully open source — view the code on GitHub.
